acceptanceCriteria: Sweep or dispatcher invokes declared operations per a policy setting, with receipts and quarantine on failure.
body: Found 2026-10-18 by the V1-1585 lane (PR beamfall/corvint#1104, head 2215d54aa, PSR-V0-160..167); recorded in docs/build-log/2026-10-18-v1-1585-pool-member-lifecycle.md. GitHub #1028 stays open for these. Expected: the dispatcher/sweep can provision, refresh or tear down members through pool operate per policy. Actual: operations are operator-invoked only.
title: Pool dispatcher and sweep do not invoke typed lifecycle operations (provision/refresh/teardown)
